title: chore: remove dead memory_monitor logging module
claim: gateway/memory_monitor.py has no production callers and can be deleted with its tests (rebuild of fork #113).

evidence.source: Zero callers is TRUE on main: git grep finds only gateway/memory_monitor.py and tests/gateway/test_memory_monitor.py. The PREMISE is false, though. The salvage body says 'startup/shutdown wiring and config were removed earlier', but the wiring was accidentally dropped (per #50472: #20059 desktop-app rewrite of gateway/run.py silently lost the #27102 blocks). Upstream issue #49773 'memory_monitor heartbeat never starts' is OPEN and reports external log-freshness watchdogs depending on the [MEMORY] heartbeat. Several external contributors have OPEN PRs restoring the wiring. Deleting the module would destroy the feature they are fixing (AGENTS.md: 'fixes that destroy the feature', 'verify the premise').

upstream_overlap: #49782 liuhao1024 OPEN (triage-named canonical: call start_memory_monitoring() from start_gateway())
notes: Do not rebuild or promote. Support rather than compete: if anything, help the #49773 cluster converge on one carrier. Also retire the older fork leaf #113 for the same reason. The fork's 915-file comparison was never used.
